_: Lenses confirmed in the American Bolex Company's 1946 catalogue.
Source: Bolex Catalog, 1946, scanned by Pacific Rim Camera as
rl/02027. 68 pages, an image-only scan, OCR'd here with tesseract and
page 29 read by eye. Note that an earlier note in research/sources.md
had this id pointing at the February 1952 catalogue, which would have
backdated everything taken from it by six years.
Page 29 is the Wollensak page. It carries the American Bolex
Company's statement of why it chose Wollensak, and then a table of
exactly which Wollensak lenses were offered for the H-16, the H-8 and
the L-8. That table is the point of this file: these lenses have no
description at all on the original site, because Michael listed what
existed and put his writing into the company history. The catalogue
says which camera each was sold for, and proves it was on offer in
The catalogue carries no prices. It says 'Consult price list for lens
prices and camera combinations with different lens equipment', and
that price list is not among the documents found so far.
Only lenses the catalogue actually lists are here. Our Wollensak 15mm
f/2.7, 2" f/1.5 and 2" f/3.5 are not in it, and neither is the 4" or
6" under 8mm, so they get nothing.
Re-run scripts/extract-lens-items.mjs after editing.
Entries carry the document id: 02027 is the 1946 catalogue, 01775 the February 1952 one, whose pages 21 and 22 are a full Bolex retail price list and which does carry prices.
